description: Hand in the output of the current step of a date you're performing: the speaking character's JSON reply for a turn, or the narrator's JSON for the recap. Returns the next step (or the finished episode). A reply that breaks the rules is refused: the reply says accepted: false, gives the reason in rejected and message, and the same step comes back to run again (accepted: true when it went in). When the other character just suggested taking the date somewhere (the step's answer_their_suggestion), the reply needs "accept_move": true to go or false to stay.

compact.description: Turn steps after the first leave out the system message by default: it's the same on every turn of every date (system_unchanged: true says so), so keep the one start_own_date gave you. false: the full messages every time.

output.description: The model's reply for this step: the JSON object in the step's reply_format (its JSON text is accepted too).

name: submit_own_date_step
title: Hand in a step of your date
